firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player; the rules suggest the player who most recently visited London. That player places their sailing barge on the first space of the era 1 river tile.
clarifications: The other players place their barges in the remaining berths in any order.
In each era, the player whose boat is on the rightmost space of the current river tile plays first, then play continues clockwise.
